reasoning_content: The settings seed doesn't set map.latitude etc. But Setting.reset_defaults should populate defaults. Let's check the setting defaults.

action.command: cd /workspace; grep -rn "map.latitude\|map_longitude\|map\.zoom\|map_latitude" app/models/ lib/ db/ config/ | grep -v locales | head -20; echo "=== reset_defaults ==="; grep -rn "def reset_defaults\|def defaults" app/models/setting.rb lib/ | head
